qualified_interpretation.type: 0x0f has no N_STAB/private-external bits, N_TYPE=0x0e (N_SECT), and N_EXT=1. These are section-defined external declarations, not ordinary undefined imports.
qualified_interpretation.section: n_sect=1 names the first section in this consumer's load-command order. Retained command1 at file offset104 has its first section header at176, and raw selected names __TEXT,__text. Section ordinals are file-local. This establishes declaration section association, not body acquisition/execution.
qualified_interpretation.descriptor: For these defined records, n_desc=0x0080 is N_WEAK_DEF. The same low bit's undefined-reference meaning is inapplicable here. Raw high8=0 is retained; the undefined-reference library-ordinal convention does not establish a selected dylib/provider/runtime binding.
qualified_interpretation.names: The selected raw spellings identify ODeviceKitSampleRateProcessor template declaration candidates for Channel Eq, Auto Filter2, Roar, Redux2, Limiter, Erosion2 and Saturator roles; names alone establish no DSP, constructor, lifecycle, ABI, input-domain, dispatch or public-route behavior.
qualified_interpretation.n_value: All 27 n_value integers were decoded as part of the selected 16-byte records and compared with Root readback. No n_value address was opened, followed, matched to a source-index entry, or used to acquire any body/provider bytes.
qualified_interpretation.runtime: A declaration associated with a stub location and a source-side EXTERNAL label is not a proven current runtime binding or actual callable destination. Weak/interposition/loader behavior and current object/argument/control identity remain unproved.
qualified_interpretation.limits: Pinned public format declarations describe metadata conventions; they do not prove which headers built Live or complete current loader behavior.

invocation_and_custody.outer_pid_limit: No outer PID was reported; none inferred from chunk ID, timestamps or other process metadata.
invocation_and_custody.timing_limit: Separate unreconciled fields; neither is treated as performance, deadline enforcement, timeout-path or execution-identity proof.
invocation_and_custody.chronology: Root selection precedes attempt start; recorded after identities end precedes final status time; Root readback and manifest follow. Attempt.json is the initial zero-count preflight record; status/tool stdout are the final result, not two attempts.
invocation_and_custody.cleanup_limits: Successful zero-child acquisition does not exercise failure/deadline cleanup. Collector signal/error receipt paths and Root external TERM/KILL deadline are source/invocation properties; actual interruption, abrupt startup failure, SIGKILL/repeated interrupt, filesystem exhaustion and escaped-session behavior were not tested. Exclusive files use flush/fsync but directory persistence/atomic complete receipts after uncatchable termination are not guaranteed.
invocation_and_custody.custody_limits: Before/after recorded identities show equal endpoint records, not continuous custody or an adversarial snapshot. Reviewer did not witness image reads/syscalls or reacquire the image. Minimal environment/core/DEVNULL/umask are supported by Root invocation receipt and source review, not an independent process trace.

negative_controls.basis: Reviewer-owned stdlib assertions and in-memory metadata mutations only, run with /usr/bin/python3 -I -B. No collector module/import/run and no synthetic image/provider access. Byte-join controls reject false retained metadata; closure controls reject unsupported promotion. These are review controls, not original-versus-model numerical tests or actual failure/timeout tests.
